###### In-ground Swimming Pool Repair, Plaster, Pool Coping, and Pool Tile Repair

# Pool Renovation & Remodeling

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLake-Pools-and-Masonry-Work-1024x768.jpeg)

![](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLake-Pools-Spa-Masonry-Work-1024x770.jpeg)

## Does Your Pool Need Some TLC?

As much as you love your pool, they require periodic repairs and renovations to keep looking and working like new. Whether it’s faded, stained, or cracked plaster that needs to be replaced, or that waterline tile that is outdated and chipping away, you’re in good hands with the SpringLake Pools repair team.

## Looking to renovate

## Your Pool or Spa

###### Call Us Now

[(570) 855-4235](tel:+15708554235)

![Home Pools](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLakePools-HomePools-1024x768.jpeg)

## Consider Your Pool Renovation with SpringLake Pools

SpringLake Pools offers plaster types with lifetime warranties that can be brought back up to good as new color without the demolition most pool plaster require. In addition, our equipment and plumbing systems are top of the line, with warranties and service professionals to back you up for the remainder of your pool ownership experience.


### WE DO ALL THE HEAVY LIFTING


Should your renovation require some heavy lifting, we’ve got you covered and will be upfront with any assessment with a free consultation and job estimate from your SpringLake Pools Design Consultant. The most important choice about a pool renovation is to pick a partner that can manage the big picture down to the smallest detail to ensure you get the best result without repeating the process anytime soon.

[Get in Touch](https://springlakepools.com/contact/)

## Common pool renovation projects include:

[Get in Touch](https://springlakepools.com/contact/)

- Replacing patio surfaces
- Refinishing interior surfaces
- Re-plastering concrete pools
- Adding, replacing or repairing coping and tile
- Upgrading pools to include smartphone-operated automation
- Installing custom benches, baja shelves, sun shelves, or tanning ledges
- Adding water features
- Changing the depth of the pool
- Adding a custom spa
- Removing concrete and installing maintenance-free travertine pavers
- Enhancing the ambience with color-changing lights or light shows
- Changing the interior color of your concrete pool and/or adding a low-maintenance pebble interior

![High-Quality Construction Process](https://springlakepools.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/SpringLakePools-Construction.jpeg)

#### Schedule Your Free Concrete Pool Remodeling Evaluation Today

You deserve a pool that looks brand new, whether you prefer a luxurious, tiled pool finish or if just want a clean, smooth surface. Contact Spring Lake Pools for all your pool renovation needs today.
